- 10m intros

Quick heads up: Redwood has an all-hands + leadership offsite the week of Oct 18–22; several senior engineers and my SE lead will be traveling and offline for parts of that week. That makes a full 60-minute live demo with the exact engineering coverage you requested on Oct 19 difficult.

Options I can offer immediately:
- Move the live demo to Tue, Oct 26 at 10:00 AM PT (my preference — full team available).
- If you need something sooner, I can run an abridged 30-minute session on Oct 19 at 10:00 AM PT with myself and Tessa covering product and playbook details; Marcus can drop in for the integration Q&A if a deeper follow-up is scheduled.
- Alternatively, we can record a focused 25-minute demo (engineering walkthrough + SSO checklist) this week and share it for your team to review asynchronously, then book a short follow-up for deep technical questions.

If Harmonix is advancing procurement quickly, please loop in procurement@harmonix.com on whether a PO/seed contract will be issued prior to the live session — that will help prioritize engineering time.

I'm copying Marcus and Tessa to confirm coverage and to propose alternate calendars.
